description: Use this when the user asks whether a forest is natural, primary, naturally regenerating, planted, a plantation or tree crops (oil palm, cocoa, coffee, rubber, orchards, agroforestry), for example for EUDR due diligence (deforestation-free sourcing, 2020 cut-off), certification, a carbon or biodiversity project or a land purchase. The area is a bbox, a place, or a place with a radius (default 1,000 m), at most about 300 km². Reads Forest Typology (ForTy) 2020 v1 by Google DeepMind, a 10 m global map, and returns the share of each class in percent and hectares (primary forest, naturally regenerating forest, planted forest, plantation forest, tree crops and agroforestry, other land), the dominant class, a map, and a GeoTIFF of the class raster clipped to the area that opens in QGIS. Caveat: 2020 baseline; planted vs naturally regenerating is the least reliable class. Not for forest loss after 2020, tree height or species. Never use the user's current location unless they type it. Download links build their file when opened; no file is saved. Never pass these links to open_gis_file.

area.description: The area: a bbox, or a place (name, address or coordinates) with an optional radius in metres. The place the user asks about, not the user's own location.
